Signalsmith Stretch (signalsmith-stretch.h), header-only C++ time/pitch
stretcher by Geraint Luff / Signalsmith Audio Ltd, MIT license.
Upstream: https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch (main
branch, no version tag at time of vendoring).

Depends on the "signalsmith-linear" library (also header-only, MIT,
Signalsmith Audio) for its STFT/FFT: only the two headers actually needed
(fft.h, stft.h) are copied into signalsmith-linear/, matching the include
path signalsmith-stretch.h expects (`#include
"signalsmith-linear/stft.h"`), instead of the full linear.h/approx.h/
platform-specific-backend files the upstream repo also ships (SIMD
backends for other targets, tests, etc. -- not needed here).
Upstream: https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear (main branch).

Copied as physical files, no submodule -- same criterion as ImGui/CLAP/
Loris (see their own VENDORED_FROM.txt / CMakeLists.txt comments in
third_party/).
